fix(create): install the default scripts on Windows (#1840)

`hubot --create` runs every npm command through the shell except the one
that installs hubot-help, hubot-rules, hubot-diagnostics and the adapter.
On Windows npm is `npm.cmd`, which spawnSync cannot start without a
shell, so that install fails with ENOENT and nothing reports it. The
generated bot then lists those scripts in external-scripts.json without
having them installed.

Run that command with `shell: true` and inherited stdio like the others.
